finding.text: `/framework/ai/asks/undone/` did not become a saved filter (requirement 2 asks for all three pages). Only a link to `?kind=ask` was added. `plan.md` gives the reason: `undone.json` holds 1167 asks but `state.asks` folds only 87, and folding them in needs `Server/State.mjs`, which the brief fences out. That is a real follow-up for the owner, not something this task can fix inside its fence — shots/asks-undone-1920.png.

`/tasks/` used to show tasks "grouped by module, ranked". It now opens a flat, newest-first Inbox list ("newest 150 of 539"), so the per-module grouping is gone — shots/tasks-400.png, chip row. That matches "the same rows the Inbox would", but the old page's view has no replacement.

At 1920 the Lanes view draws only two columns: Landed today drops under In flight and leaves the right half of the page empty, even though there is room for three columns — shots/tasks-lanes-1920.png. This probably happened before this change too (the same tasks.css); it is worth a follow-up because Lanes exists to show all of today at once.

The Inbox chip counts now apply the other groups' filters (Today under Kind: task counts tasks only), and a new Home chip was added. Both change the main Inbox, not just a preset, which goes past the rail fence ("only to export a preset"). `plan.md` records both as decisions.
`DashChips.note_bad` returns the colour string, not the view (`… .el.style.color = "#c62828"`). It was moved unchanged from TasksPage and no caller uses the return value.
